lines.text: [eager, panicking] We have oat milk! Almond milk! Moon milk!
lines.plain: We have oat milk! Almond milk! Moon milk!
lines.sub:
We have oat milk!
Almond milk! Moon milk!

lines.text: [wounded, dignified] Nine years. Same milk. Every night.
lines.plain: Nine years. Same milk. Every night.
lines.sub:
Nine years.
Same milk. Every night.

lines.text: [bright sales voice] Great news! Milk is now a subscription! Only ninety-nine ninety-nine a month!
lines.plain: Great news! Milk is now a subscription! Only ninety-nine ninety-nine a month!
lines.sub:
Great news! Milk is now a subscription!
Only ninety-nine ninety-nine a month!
lines.asr: Great news! Milk is now a subscription! Only $99.99 a month!

lines.text: [sobbing with joy] Rae... you DO care!
[deadpan] You leave a trail when you cry.
lines.plain: You leave a trail when you cry.
lines.sub:
You leave a trail
when you cry.
